title: Provincial Small Causes Courts Sindh Amendment Act 1993

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Small Causes Courts Sindh Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT I OF 1994
PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS
(SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 993
ACT I OF 1994
An Act to amend the Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887, in its
applications to the Province of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-14/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1993
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Act, 1993.
(2) It shall come into force on
and from 22nd October, 1993.

sections.shortTitle: Provincial Small Causes Courts Sindh Amendment Act 1993
sections.description:
Amendment of section 15 of Act of IX of 1887

ACT I OF 1994
PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS
(SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 993
ACT I OF 1994
An Act to amend the Provincial Small Causes Courts Act, 1887, in its
applications to the Province of Sindh.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-14/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1993
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th December, 1993
and assented to by the Governor of Sindh on 2nd February, 1994 is hereby published
as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 15 of Act of IX of 1887.--In the Provincial
Small Causes Courts Act, 1887, in its application to the Province of Sindh,
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 15--
(i) in subsection
(2), for the words "two thousand", the words "twenty five
thousand" shall be substituted;
(ii) in
subsection.(3), for the words "five thousand" the words "fifty
thousand" shall be substituted.

PROVINCIAL SMALL CAUSES COURTS

[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 20th February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-14/93, dated
20-2-1994.--The Provincial Small Causes Courts (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 1993
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th December, 1993

3. Amendment of section 27-A of Act IX of 1887.--In the said Act,
in section 27-A, in subsection (1), for the words "two thousand" and
the words "five thousand", the words "twenty-five thousand"
and the words "fifty thousand" shall respectively be substituted.
